name: Happy_4
short_caption: The robot pulls both hands slightly inward and performs a brief, happy bobbing motion with its torso and head.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot brings both hands slightly inward and upward toward its midsection with open, relaxed palms. It then performs a gentle, rhythmic bobbing motion of its head and upper torso, swaying slightly from side to side to convey a cheerful mood. Finally, it smoothly lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting pose.
